|lore=Leader. Gambler. Fair pilot. Lando was given the rank of general for “a little maneuver” at the Battle of Taanab. Willing to lead Rebel starfighters in a crazy attack.<ref name="foil-face" />
|game_text=Deploys −2 aboard Falcon. Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. When piloting a freighter, adds 1 to maneuver and draws one battle destiny if not able to otherwise. When he attempts to “blow away” Death Star II, adds 2 to total.<ref name="foil-face" />
